params.body:
The gateway reads its policy, as `docs/working-set.md` proposed: no more carrying a configuration over from the laptop and rebooting the VM to change a grant.

**A version** is a token in the working set's form, `base64url(payload).base64url(Ed25519 signature)`: type `policy-version`, issuer, number, the hash of the version before it (the carried configuration for version 1), when it was signed, every hand's grant, the systems' addresses, and the change in the words the signer was shown (row 4.1.6). Unknown fields are refused.

**Who signs.** The carried configuration names the keys under `policy_log.signers` and is measured into RTMR3 with them. The owner's token keys (`widen`) may sign any version. Elixir's key (`narrow`) may sign only a version the gateway itself finds narrower (`policy.Narrower`: no new hand, kind, resource, task, system or accepted judgement; no higher count; no certificate or per-action word dropped; nothing about who speaks changed; no system moved). Anything else from a narrowing key is refused by name.

**Forward only.** The very next number, naming the served version's hash: a replayed older version, a skipped number or a fork is refused, and a refused version blocks every later one until one that follows arrives.

**Applied and measured.** A root timer (`control-policy`, every minute) runs `--pull-policy`: it asks `policy_log.url?after=<version>` with the gateway's Portal token, judges, keeps what holds in `/var/lib/control/policy-log.json`, and exits 3 when it kept one; the unit restarts the gateway, whose `--attest` extends RTMR3 with each applied version after the binary and the carried configuration (`attest.ExtendFrom` extends only what the register lacks) and takes a fresh quote before the first action under it (row 6.1.3). Every record carries `control_policy`, `v<n> sha-256:…`; `/v1/agents` names the version served and `/v1/policy` serves it whole, for Elixir to draft on. A new carry-over starts again at v0.

The disclosed gap on a lagging grant (conformance statement) closes once this runs: a narrowing reaches the gateway within the minute. The statement itself is updated when it is deployed and carried over once with `policy_log`. The passkey inside a working set stays an open question in the design note: the set names Portal projects, the gateway knows repositories.

Tests: `policy/log_test.go` (chain, signatures, every narrowing case), `cmd/gateway/policylog_test.go` (pull, keep, replay, refusal, carry-over, the claim on records, `/v1/policy`), `attest` (`ExtendFrom`). `go vet` and `go test ./...` pass.
params.title: The gateway reads its policy: signed versions, forward only, measured on arrival
